column2: Thiscommittee consists of an external IT consultant inaddition to the Board members viz. Mr. M.D.Ranganath (Chairman), Mr.Srikanth Nadhamuni, Mr.Sashidhar Jagdishan,and Mr. Atanu Chakraborty. During the year,Mrs.Shyamala Gopinath ceased to be amemberof the Commitee pursuant to the cessation of her tenure as directorof the Bank,while Mr.Atanu Chakrabortyand Mr.Sashidhar Jagdishan were inductedas members
of the Committee with effect from June 9, 2021. TheCommitee metfive (5)timesduring theyearonJuly14,2020,October9,2020,January7,2021,February122021, and March 26,2021.
